_readme: The lesson-to-page map. This file is the ONLY place the mapping lives, and
it was read off the books themselves — every boundary below was checked
against the page it claims to start on.
`pages` are PDF page numbers, 1-based, counting from the first page of the
file. They are NOT the numbers printed at the bottom of the page: this is
an extract, so PDF page 3 of the maths book carries the printed number 16.
The PDF number is what addresses the page in the file and in the rendered
image cache, so it is what the database stores.
Pages left out of every lesson are deliberate: unit title photographs,
concept dividers, and the notes-for-parents pages. Nothing teaches from
them, so nothing maps to them.
scripts/ingest_curriculum.py loads this. Editing it and re-running the
ingest is how the map changes — nothing else writes curriculum_pages.
